A1.justification: Both PDFs describe Backward Conformal Prediction by the same authors. Their main text, figures, equations and appendices are readable and support reliable matching, including the replaced Appendix D.

before.justification: Section 4 and Appendix B report original CIFAR-10 and Breast Cancer Wisconsin experiments, including empirical coverage and coverage-estimation results.

after.justification: Section 4 and Appendix B retain original classification and coverage-estimation results for fixed and adaptive prediction-set sizes.

M1.justification: Algorithm 1, the e-value construction, adaptive miscoverage selection, leave-one-out estimator and entropy-based size rule are retained. The revision changes their theoretical justification without changing the prediction procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate CIFAR-10 image classification and Breast Cancer Wisconsin binary classification, including the same fixed and adaptive size scenarios. No additional dataset or evaluated task appears.

E2.justification: Appendix B.2 retains the comparison with standard conformal prediction at fixed alpha=0.02 and alpha equal to the mean adaptive miscoverage. No evaluated comparator is added or removed.

E3.justification: The training settings, calibration sizes, size constraints and binary-search tolerance remain unchanged. Appendix B also retains the 70/30 cancer-data split and the adaptive rule using 20 nearest neighbors.

E4.justification: The calibration-size and prediction-size analyses, pseudo-miscoverage histograms and adaptive-size illustration in Figures 3–8 are retained. No new ablation, robustness test or case study is reported.

E5.justification: The new checklist explicitly describes the experimental runs as independent. Both versions already report 200 runs and their distributions; this adds a limited clarification, without increasing run counts or introducing seeds, confidence intervals or significance tests.

E6.justification: Figures 3–8 retain their plotted results and coverage-estimation trends. The reported 91.1% CIFAR-10 and 97.7% cancer test accuracies, and the conformal-set counts in Appendix B.2, are also unchanged.

T1.justification: Proposition 2.2 replaces the normalized post-hoc inequality and Taylor approximation with an exact marginal coverage guarantee for arbitrary adaptive miscoverage. Appendix D's second-moment bound and Corollary D.2 are replaced by a Jensen/supremum proof of this stronger proposition. Section 3's consistency and variance results remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract and introduction remove the Taylor-approximation qualification from the central coverage claim. V4 presents coverage of at least one minus expected adaptive miscoverage as exact under exchangeability, substantially strengthening the claimed guarantee.

C2.justification: V2 explains that the Taylor argument requires adaptive miscoverage to concentrate around its mean. V4 removes this qualification and interprets the unchanged experimental coverage as confirmation of an exact inequality in Section 4 and Appendix B. This changes the stated validity boundary; the separate stability limitation remains.

D1.justification: New checklist items state that the datasets are public and promise public code release upon acceptance. They provide no code-access location. Existing implementation settings, CPU information and per-trial timing remain unchanged.

R1.justification: V4 adds Larsson, Ramdas and Ruf (2025) and an optimality characterization of the chosen e-variable. Appendix D attributes its replacement proof to the already cited Koning work. Appendix A's positioning remains unchanged; Koning's year/suffix updates do not introduce additional works.

P1.justification: V4 inserts a NeurIPS checklist and makes focused edits to the abstract, validity exposition, experimental interpretations and acknowledgments. Appendix D is rewritten around the replacement proposition, while the main section ordering and most retained prose remain stable.

P2.justification: Figure 1 moves from page 3 to page 2, loses its Taylor-approximation label and revises its decision text and caption. Figure 2 is enlarged. The other figures retain their content; the checklist insertion causes additional pagination changes.

improvement.justification: V2 explicitly qualifies Equation (2) as Taylor-approximate; v4 asserts it exactly, but the replacement proof contains a decisive error. Appendix D equates 1−1/e with sup over a>0 of (1{e≥1/a}−a); for e<1 these are negative and zero, respectively. Thus the new proof does not establish the stronger central guarantee. Removing the qualification substantially weakens theoretical reliability, outweighing the limited disclosure and presentation gains.
